participant_id.Description: BIDS label = patient code used in the release (HUP### / MP#### for MUSC, public pseudonyms of the source)

Levels.HUP: Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania

sex.Description: From OpenNeuro ds004100 participants.tsv (HUP patients in that dataset only); not in the Pennsieve release

age.Description: From OpenNeuro ds004100 participants.tsv (HUP patients in that dataset only); not in the Pennsieve release

source_sampling_frequency.Description: Sampling rate of the iEEG.org recording (patientList.fs)

ilae.Description: patientList.ILAE as released (surgical outcome, ILAE class; n/a where empty)

engel.Description: patientList.Engel as released (numeric coding of the Engel class as in the release, e.g. 3.1)

soz_laterality.Description: patientList.soz as released (seizure onset zone laterality)

temporal.Description: patientList.istemp as released (1 = temporal seizure onset)

in_gw_set.Description: 1 = networks in the grey/white (gw) analysis set

in_LR_set.Description: 1 = networks in the left/right (LR) lateralisation set

n_network_files.Description: Number of network files for this patient (5 epochs per set)
